subject: afrikaans-fal
description: Afrikaans First Additional Language skill tree, Grades 1-6 (CAPS Foundation Phase 1-3 + Intermediate Phase 4-6). Strands shift at IP: Foundation Phase uses Luister / Klanke / Woordeskat / Lees & Kyk / Taalstruktuur (oral-heavy); Intermediate Phase uses Luister / Lees en Kyk / Skryf en Aanbied / Taalstrukture (reading + writing become first-class). Praat (speaking-aloud) and essay-length writing remain DEFERRED. Item delivery follows the same tap/choice/cloze/sequence templates as Life Skills (no LLM grading in scope).

levels.title: Graad 1 — Afrikaans Eerste Addisionele Taal
levels.description: CAPS Foundation Phase Grade 1 FAL. Heavily oral in CAPS; in this knowledge-core build the receptive half (listening comprehension) is delivered and speaking-production is deferred. Strands: Luister, Klanke, Woordeskat, Lees & Kyk, Taalstruktuur. Vocabulary target: 700-1000 words by year end. Scaffolding (instructions, hints) is in English (home language) per FAL pedagogy; the target content is Afrikaans.

tiers.title: Luister (Listening comprehension)
tiers.description: Receptive listening only. Audio plays Afrikaans; the child taps/chooses. Speaking-aloud production is deferred to Phase 2.

atomic_skills.title: Volg gesproke instruksies (follow spoken instructions)
atomic_skills.description: Respond to one or two simple spoken Afrikaans instructions by tapping the right object/picture, e.g. 'Wys vir my die rooi bal' (Show me the red ball). Total Physical Response style.

error_signatures.description: Learner does only part of a one- or two-step instruction
error_signatures.example: 'Wys vir my die rooi bal' — learner taps a ball but ignores the colour cue.

error_signatures.description: A critical noun, colour or number in the instruction is not heard
error_signatures.example: Audio says 'die GROOT hond'; learner picks the small dog.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Replay the instruction slowly. Drop to a single-step instruction with two clearly different picture choices before adding a second step.

atomic_skills.title: Verstaan alledaagse frases en groete (understand everyday phrases & greetings)
atomic_skills.description: Understand the meaning of common greetings and classroom phrases heard in Afrikaans, e.g. 'Goeie môre', 'Hoe gaan dit?', 'Mag ek asseblief...' — pick the right meaning or the right reply.

error_signatures.description: Learner translates a greeting word-for-word and loses the chunk meaning
error_signatures.example: 'Goeie môre' interpreted as 'good face' rather than 'good morning'.

error_signatures.description: Learner connects the phrase to the wrong scene
error_signatures.example: ''n Mag ek asseblief...' matched to leaving instead of asking.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Anchor each phrase to a familiar situation (a picture of two people greeting). Replay audio and offer the English meaning as a hint before the Afrikaans choices.

atomic_skills.title: Beantwoord vrae oor 'n storie (answer questions about a heard story)
atomic_skills.description: Listen to a short, simple Afrikaans story or description and answer Wie? (who), Wat? (what), Hoeveel? (how many) comprehension questions.

error_signatures.description: Learner mixes up who did what in the heard story
error_signatures.example: Story says the cat slept; learner says the dog slept.

error_signatures.description: Learner replaces a heard detail with a similar wrong one
error_signatures.example: Audio: 'drie appels'; learner picks 'two apples'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Re-read the story one sentence at a time. Ask the question right after the matching sentence. Use the picture to support recall.

tiers.title: Klanke (Phonics / sound awareness)
tiers.description: Grade 1 FAL phonics is ORAL sound awareness (not letter decoding yet — that starts Grade 2). All items are audio-first: the child hears Afrikaans sounds/words and chooses. Clean prerequisite chain.

atomic_skills.title: Herken rymwoorde (identify rhyming words)
atomic_skills.description: Hear Afrikaans words and identify which ones rhyme, e.g. kat / mat / hoed — which two sound the same at the end.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks words that share a starting sound, not an ending sound
error_signatures.example: kat / koek picked as rhyming (both /k/) instead of kat / mat.

error_signatures.description: Learner can't isolate the final phoneme
error_signatures.example: Hears 'kat' but can't tell what comes after 'ka-'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Exaggerate and stretch the ending sound. Compare just two words at a time before offering three choices.

atomic_skills.title: Herken beginklanke (recognise beginning sounds)
atomic_skills.description: Identify the first sound of a familiar Afrikaans word, e.g. /k/ in 'kat', /h/ in 'hoed' — choose the word that starts with a given sound.

error_signatures.description: Learner identifies the final sound when asked for the first
error_signatures.example: Asked for the first sound of 'kat'; learner says /t/.

error_signatures.description: Learner confuses voiced/unvoiced or near pairs (b/p, d/t, k/g)
error_signatures.example: Says 'kat' starts with /g/.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Say the word, then say it again with the first sound held long (k-k-kat). Offer two words with very different starts before three.

atomic_skills.title: Verdeel sinne in woorde (split sentences into words)
atomic_skills.description: Hear a short Afrikaans sentence and count or tap how many words it has, e.g. 'Die kat slaap' = 3 words (one clap per word).

error_signatures.description: Learner is one word out when counting words in a sentence
error_signatures.example: 'Die kat slaap' counted as 4 words because of the article.

error_signatures.description: Learner counts compound nouns or contractions as one word still and gets confused
error_signatures.example: 'huiswerk' counted as two.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Clap each word with the child. Start with two-word sentences before three- and four-word ones.

atomic_skills.title: Verdeel woorde in lettergrepe (split words into syllables)
atomic_skills.description: Hear an Afrikaans word and count its syllables (claps), e.g. ska-pe = 2, pie-sang = 2, skoen-lap-per = 3.

error_signatures.description: Learner miscounts the syllables (off by one)
error_signatures.example: 'ska-pe' counted as 1 syllable.

error_signatures.description: Learner splits a consonant cluster into a fake syllable
error_signatures.example: 'skoen' clapped as 'sk-oen', two syllables.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Clap and say each chunk slowly. Use the child's own name first, then one- and two-syllable words before longer ones.

atomic_skills.title: Onderskei aanvangsklank en res (onset and rime)
atomic_skills.description: Split a simple word into its first sound and the rest, e.g. k-at, m-at, l-at; choose the word made from a given onset + rime.

error_signatures.description: Learner changes the rime when asked to keep it constant
error_signatures.example: Onset k + rime -at: learner picks 'kop' instead of 'kat'.

error_signatures.description: Learner cannot swap the onset to form a new word
error_signatures.example: Asked for k → m on '-at', learner picks 'kat'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Say the onset and rime separated by a pause (k ... at), then blend them. Keep the rime constant across choices (-at) so only the first sound changes.

atomic_skills.title: Herken meervoude (klank) (recognise plurals by ear)
atomic_skills.description: Hear a noun and its plural and notice the change in sound, e.g. boek/boeke, kat/katte, sok/sokkies — pick the one that means more than one.

error_signatures.description: Learner can't hear the plural-ending change (-e, -te, -s)
error_signatures.example: Picks 'kat' as the plural form instead of 'katte'.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks the form with stress they remember even if singular
error_signatures.example: Single 'boek' chosen as plural because it's spoken louder.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Show one object then many, saying the singular then plural. Stress the added ending sound (-e, -te, -s).

tiers.title: Woordeskat (Vocabulary, themed)
tiers.description: Themed Afrikaans vocabulary building toward 700-1000 words. Picture-heavy (image-match): hear/read the Afrikaans word, tap the matching picture. Items carry image_refs keyed to the manifest in scripts/afrikaans-image-manifest.md; until the image set is supplied they fall back to audio + English-meaning choices.

atomic_skills.title: Kleure (colours)
atomic_skills.description: Core Afrikaans colour words: rooi, blou, geel, groen, swart, wit, oranje, pers, bruin, pienk.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks a similar colour instead of the named one
error_signatures.example: 'pers' (purple) picked when 'blou' was said.

error_signatures.description: Learner taps the wrong picture because the colour names sound similar in their own language
error_signatures.example: 'rooi' (red) confused with English 'roof'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Pair each colour word with a clear block of that colour. Practise two contrasting colours before adding more.

atomic_skills.title: Liggaamsdele (body parts)
atomic_skills.description: Afrikaans body-part words: kop, hare, oë, ore, neus, mond, arms, hande, bene, voete.

error_signatures.description: Learner taps a different body part on the figure
error_signatures.example: Asked for 'neus' (nose); learner taps the mouth.

error_signatures.description: Learner confuses 'oog' (one eye) with 'oë' (eyes)
error_signatures.example: 'oë' picked for a one-eye image.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Let the child point to the body part on themselves as they hear the word. Start with face parts before limbs.

atomic_skills.title: My klere (clothes)
atomic_skills.description: Afrikaans clothing words: hemp, broek, rok, trui, sokkies, skoene, hoed, jas.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks a different garment on the figure
error_signatures.example: 'hemp' (shirt) picked when 'broek' (pants) was said.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Link each word to a picture of someone wearing the item. Group by where it is worn (top, bottom, feet, head).

atomic_skills.title: Voedsel (food)
atomic_skills.description: Afrikaans food words: appel, piesang, lemoen, brood, melk, eier, kos, water, pap.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks a food from the wrong group (fruit vs bread vs egg)
error_signatures.example: 'piesang' picked when 'brood' was said.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Use pictures of single, recognisable foods. Practise fruits as one set before mixing food types.

atomic_skills.title: Diere (animals)
atomic_skills.description: Afrikaans animal words: hond, kat, koei, perd, skaap, voël, vis, hoender, olifant.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks an animal of the wrong size class
error_signatures.example: 'kat' picked when 'koei' was said.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Pair each animal word with its picture and, where helpful, its sound. Start with pets/farm animals the child knows.

atomic_skills.title: Die weer (weather)
atomic_skills.description: Afrikaans weather words: son, reën, wind, wolk, koud, warm, sneeu.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks a weather word that doesn't match the picture
error_signatures.example: 'reen' picked when 'son' image is shown.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Connect each word to today's weather or a clear weather picture. Contrast pairs (koud/warm, son/reën).

atomic_skills.title: Vorms, grootte en rigting (shapes, size, direction)
atomic_skills.description: Afrikaans words for shape/size/position: groot, klein, sirkel, vierkant, op, onder, in, langs.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks the wrong basic shape
error_signatures.example: 'driehoek' picked when 'sirkel' was said.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks the opposite direction word
error_signatures.example: 'links' picked when 'regs' was said.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Demonstrate position words with a real object (a ball on/under a box). Contrast opposites (groot/klein, op/onder).

tiers.title: Lees & Kyk (Reading & viewing)
tiers.description: Emergent reading in Afrikaans: recognising whole words by sight, reading environmental labels, matching words to pictures, and simple comprehension. Builds on sight-word recognition.

atomic_skills.title: Herken sigwoorde (recognise sight words)
atomic_skills.description: Recognise high-frequency Afrikaans sight words by sight: die, en, is, was, hy, sy, ek, ons, kan, hulle.

error_signatures.description: Learner tries to sound out a high-frequency sight word instead of recognising it
error_signatures.example: 'die' read as /d/-/i/-/e/.

error_signatures.description: Learner reads a similar-looking word
error_signatures.example: 'dit' read as 'die'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Show the word and say it together a few times. Compare two words that look different before similar-looking ones (hy/sy).

atomic_skills.title: Lees etikette in die omgewing (read environmental labels)
atomic_skills.description: Read common labelled words from the classroom/environment and match them to the object: deur, venster, kas, bord, stoel, tafel; everyday signs oop/toe, in/uit.

error_signatures.description: Learner matches a label to the wrong nearby picture
error_signatures.example: 'venster' matched to the door.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks the picture from another label in the scene
error_signatures.example: Label says 'stoel'; learner taps the table.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Point to the real labelled object as the word is read. Practise opposites together (oop/toe).

atomic_skills.title: Pas onderskrif by prent (match caption to picture)
atomic_skills.description: Match a short Afrikaans caption or word to the picture it describes, e.g. 'Die rooi bal' to the right image.

error_signatures.description: Learner matches a caption to the wrong picture
error_signatures.example: ''n hond' matched to a picture of a cat.

error_signatures.description: Learner ignores the adjective in the caption
error_signatures.example: ''n rooi bal' matched to a blue ball.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Read the caption aloud while pointing to each word. Reduce to a single keyword (rooi, bal) if the full caption is too much.

atomic_skills.title: Beantwoord begripsvrae (answer comprehension questions)
atomic_skills.description: After a short shared-reading text with a picture, answer simple Afrikaans comprehension questions (Wie? Wat? Waar?).

error_signatures.description: Learner substitutes a similar but wrong detail from a read text
error_signatures.example: Text said three apples; learner picks two.

error_signatures.description: Learner answers a different W-question than asked
error_signatures.example: Asked WHERE; learner gives a WHO answer.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Re-read the relevant sentence and point to the picture detail that answers the question.

tiers.title: Taalstruktuur en -gebruik (Language structure & use)
tiers.description: Grade 1 grammar in meaningful context: present tense, negation, question words, pronouns, modal verbs, plurals, possessives, prepositions, adjectives/adverbs. Delivered as choice/cloze/true-false.

atomic_skills.title: Teenwoordige tyd (present tense)
atomic_skills.description: Understand and use simple present-tense sentences, e.g. 'Sy hou van skool', 'Ek speel'.

error_signatures.description: Learner adds an extra ending to the verb to 'agree' with the subject
error_signatures.example: 'Hy speels' instead of 'Hy speel'.

error_signatures.description: Past or future form picked when present is required
error_signatures.example: 'Ek het gespeel' for a present-tense slot.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Act out the action while saying the sentence. Keep the subject simple (ek/sy) and the verb familiar.

atomic_skills.title: Ontkenning (negation)
atomic_skills.description: Understand the Afrikaans double-negative pattern, e.g. 'Sy lees nie', 'Ek hou nie van pere nie', 'Moenie hardloop nie'.

error_signatures.description: Learner forms a negative with only one 'nie' (English habit)
error_signatures.example: 'Ek hou nie van melk' instead of 'Ek hou nie van melk nie'.

error_signatures.description: The second 'nie' is misplaced in the sentence
error_signatures.example: 'Ek hou nie nie van melk'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Contrast a positive sentence with its negative version side by side. Highlight the two 'nie' words that wrap the idea.

atomic_skills.title: Vraagsinne (question words)
atomic_skills.description: Understand simple Afrikaans question words: Wat? Hoe? Hoeveel? Wie? — match the question to the right kind of answer.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks the wrong question word
error_signatures.example: 'Wie' chosen when 'Waar' was needed.

error_signatures.description: Learner doesn't recognise the line as a question
error_signatures.example: Reads 'Wat is jou naam' as a statement.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Tie each question word to what it asks for (Wie = a person, Hoeveel = a number). Use a picture so the answer is visible.

atomic_skills.title: Persoonlike voornaamwoorde (personal pronouns)
atomic_skills.description: Understand and use Afrikaans personal pronouns: ek, jy, hy, sy, ons, hulle.

error_signatures.description: 'hy' used for a female subject or 'sy' for a male
error_signatures.example: Mia replaced with 'hy'.

error_signatures.description: Subject form used where object form is needed
error_signatures.example: 'Ek sien hy' instead of 'Ek sien hom'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Point to who the pronoun means (me = ek, the boy = hy). Practise ek/jy first, then hy/sy, then ons/hulle.

atomic_skills.title: Modale werkwoorde (modal verbs: mag, kan)
atomic_skills.description: Understand and use 'kan' (can) and 'mag' (may), e.g. 'Ek kan spring', 'Mag ek uitgaan?'.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks 'kan' when 'mag' (permission) is needed, or vice versa
error_signatures.example: 'Mag ek loop?' answered with the meaning of 'kan' (able to).

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Link 'kan' to ability (show it) and 'mag' to asking permission. Use classroom requests the child knows.

atomic_skills.title: Meervoude (plurals)
atomic_skills.description: Form and recognise plurals of familiar nouns, e.g. boek/boeke, kat/katte, appel/appels.

error_signatures.description: Learner applies the wrong plural ending
error_signatures.example: kat → 'kats' instead of 'katte'.

error_signatures.description: Learner forgets to double the consonant before -e
error_signatures.example: bal → 'bale' instead of 'balle'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Show one then many objects. Group nouns by their plural ending (-e, -s, -te) and practise one group at a time.

atomic_skills.title: Besitlike voornaamwoorde (possessive pronouns)
atomic_skills.description: Understand and use Afrikaans possessives: my, jou, sy, haar, ons; myne, syne, hare.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks 'sy' (his) for a female owner, or 'haar' (her) for a male
error_signatures.example: Mia se boek → 'sy boek'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Hold up an object and say whose it is (my potlood, jou boek). Practise my/jou before sy/haar.

atomic_skills.title: Voorsetsels (prepositions)
atomic_skills.description: Understand Afrikaans position words: op, in, onder, langs, by, uit.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks the wrong spatial preposition
error_signatures.example: 'op' picked when the ball is 'onder' the box.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Demonstrate with a real object (the cat is op/onder/in the box). Contrast two positions at a time.

atomic_skills.title: Byvoeglike naamwoorde en bywoorde (adjectives & adverbs)
atomic_skills.description: Understand simple Afrikaans describing words: gelukkig, hartseer, groot, klein (adjectives); vinnig, stadig (adverbs).

error_signatures.description: Learner picks the opposite adjective (or adverb)
error_signatures.example: 'gelukkig' picked when 'hartseer' was the right one.

error_signatures.description: Adjective picked where adverb was needed
error_signatures.example: 'vinnig' (adverb) gap filled with 'vinnige' (adjective).

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Match each describing word to a clear picture or action (a happy face, running fast). Practise opposite pairs.

levels.title: Graad 2 — Afrikaans Eerste Addisionele Taal
levels.description: CAPS Foundation Phase Grade 2 FAL. Reading and phonics now carry more weight than in Grade 1: Klanke moves from oral sound-awareness to LETTER-SOUND DECODING (3-letter blending/segmenting, word families, consonant blends, vowel digraphs). Taalstruktuur introduces the past tense and sequence/timelines. Vocabulary target: 1000-2000 words by year end. Knowledge-core scope: Speaking-production and Writing/Handwriting remain deferred. Many skills prerequisite their Grade 1 counterpart so a Grade 2 learner builds on, not repeats, Grade 1.

tiers.title: Luister (Listening comprehension)
tiers.description: Receptive listening, extended from Grade 1: multi-step instructions, identifying from description, and fuller story comprehension (events in sequence).

atomic_skills.title: Volg opeenvolgende instruksies (follow consecutive instructions)
atomic_skills.description: Respond to two short consecutive Afrikaans instructions, e.g. 'Trek 'n sirkel. Kleur dit rooi in.' (Draw a circle. Colour it red.)

error_signatures.description: Learner does only one of two consecutive steps
error_signatures.example: 'Trek 'n sirkel. Kleur dit rooi in.' — learner draws but skips the colouring.

error_signatures.description: Steps performed in wrong order
error_signatures.example: Colour first then draw.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Replay and break into one step at a time. Confirm the first step before adding the second.

atomic_skills.title: Identifiseer voorwerp uit beskrywing (identify object from description)
atomic_skills.description: Listen to a simple Afrikaans description and choose the object/picture it describes, e.g. 'Dit is rond en rooi. Jy speel daarmee.' → bal.

error_signatures.description: Learner ignores a key attribute (round, red, you play with it)
error_signatures.example: 'Dit is rond en rooi' — learner picks a green object.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Re-read the description one clue at a time and let the child rule options out clue by clue.

atomic_skills.title: Beantwoord vrae oor 'n storie — gebeure in volgorde (story comprehension: events in order)
atomic_skills.description: Listen to a short Afrikaans story and answer comprehension questions, including what happened first/next/last.

error_signatures.description: Learner drops an event from the heard sequence
error_signatures.example: Three-event story but learner orders only two.

error_signatures.description: Events recalled in the wrong order
error_signatures.example: Places ending before beginning.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Re-read the story and pause after each event. Ask 'what happened next?' before the ordering question.

tiers.title: Klanke (Phonics / decoding)
tiers.description: Grade 2 moves from oral sound-awareness to LETTER-SOUND decoding. Letters are now shown on screen; audio plays the sounds. Strong prerequisite chain: letter-sounds -> 3-letter blending -> word families / blends / vowel digraphs.

atomic_skills.title: Onderskei verwarrende klanke (distinguish confusable sounds)
atomic_skills.description: Tell apart Afrikaans sounds that are easily confused, e.g. mier vs muur, bal vs bel.

error_signatures.description: Learner confuses voiced/unvoiced pairs (b/p, d/t, g/k)
error_signatures.example: 'bad' read as 'pad'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Say the two words back to back, exaggerating the differing vowel. Show the letters so the child links sound to spelling.

atomic_skills.title: Letter-klank verhoudings (letter-sound relationships)
atomic_skills.description: Match single Afrikaans letters to their sounds, e.g. which letter makes /m/, /s/, /k/. Note where the sound differs from English.

error_signatures.description: Learner produces the wrong sound for a letter
error_signatures.example: Letter 'v' sounded as English /v/ instead of Afrikaans /f/.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Show the letter, say its sound, give a key word (m -> /m/ -> mat). Start with letters that sound the same as English.

atomic_skills.title: Bou en breek 3-letterwoorde (build & break 3-letter words)
atomic_skills.description: Blend and segment simple CVC Afrikaans words, e.g. k-a-t -> kat, p-e-n -> pen, s-o-n -> son.

error_signatures.description: Learner can't blend k-a-t into 'kat'
error_signatures.example: Reads k-a-t as three separate sounds without blending.

error_signatures.description: Learner can't break a 3-letter word into sounds
error_signatures.example: 'pen' segmented as 'pen' (one sound).

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Sound each letter with a finger tap, then sweep to blend. For segmenting, stretch the word and tap each sound.

atomic_skills.title: Woordfamilies (word families)
atomic_skills.description: Group Afrikaans words that share a rime into families, e.g. kos/los/pos, kat/mat/lat, pen/hen/den.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks a word from a different family
error_signatures.example: Asked for the -at family; picks 'kop'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Fix the ending and swap the first letter. Read the family as a list so the pattern is heard.

atomic_skills.title: Herken eindklanke (recognise end sounds)
atomic_skills.description: Notice common end sounds in Afrikaans, e.g. plural -e/-s and diminutive -tjie/-jie (kat->katjie, hond->hondjie).

error_signatures.description: Learner can't isolate the final phoneme
error_signatures.example: Asked for the last sound of 'pen'; learner says /e/.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Say base word then changed word, stressing the added ending. Compare two endings at a time.

atomic_skills.title: Konsonanttweeklanke (consonant blends)
atomic_skills.description: Recognise and build words with common Afrikaans consonant blends at the start/end, e.g. st-, dr-, sk-, -nd, -rd (staan, drink, hand, perd).

error_signatures.description: Learner pronounces the blend as two separate sounds with a pause
error_signatures.example: 'skoen' as 'se-koen'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Say the two consonants joined (st, dr) before the rest of the word. Build from the blend outward.

atomic_skills.title: Vokaaltweeklanke (vowel digraphs)
atomic_skills.description: Recognise Afrikaans double-vowel sounds: oo, ee, uu, aa, e.g. b-oo-t, l-ee-r, m-uu-r, m-aa-n.

error_signatures.description: Learner reads a vowel digraph as two single vowels
error_signatures.example: 'oe' in 'boek' read as 'o' + 'e'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Contrast the short vowel with the long double vowel (man vs maan). Hold the long sound.

tiers.title: Woordeskat (Vocabulary, themed)
tiers.description: Grade 2 themes (feelings, seasons, time/sequence) plus action verbs that feed the past tense. Building toward 1000-2000 words. Image-match keys in afrikaans-image-manifest.md; audio + English-meaning fallback until images exist.

atomic_skills.title: Gevoelens (feelings)
atomic_skills.description: Afrikaans feeling words: bly, hartseer, kwaad, bang, moeg, opgewonde.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks a feeling face that doesn't match the word
error_signatures.example: 'hartseer' (sad) matched to the happy face.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Match each feeling to a clear face. Practise opposite pairs (bly/hartseer).

atomic_skills.title: Seisoene (seasons)
atomic_skills.description: Afrikaans seasons: lente, somer, herfs, winter.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks a season detail from a different season
error_signatures.example: 'sneeu' attached to summer.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Link each season to a clear picture and the weather word the child knows (winter/koud).

atomic_skills.title: Tyd en volgorde (time & sequence words)
atomic_skills.description: Afrikaans time/sequence vocabulary: dae van die week, gister, vandag, môre, eers, toe, daarna.

error_signatures.description: Learner confuses time words (oggend / aand / nag)
error_signatures.example: 'aand' picked for a sunrise picture.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Order the days/words on a line. Anchor gister/vandag/môre to a calendar.

atomic_skills.title: Kos en drinkgoed — uitgebrei (food & drink, extended)
atomic_skills.description: More Afrikaans food/drink words building on Grade 1: vleis, groente, vrugte, sap, tee, koek, kaas.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks a food from a different group
error_signatures.example: 'kaas' picked when a fruit was named.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Group by category (vrugte, groente). Use single clear food pictures.

atomic_skills.title: Aksiewoorde (action verbs)
atomic_skills.description: Common Afrikaans action verbs (feed the past tense): hardloop, spring, sit, staan, eet, drink, slaap, lees, skryf, speel.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks the wrong action for the named verb
error_signatures.example: 'spring' (jump) matched to a sitting figure.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Act out each verb. Pair the word with a picture of the action.

tiers.title: Lees & Kyk (Reading & viewing)
tiers.description: Reading carries more weight in Grade 2: growing sight vocabulary, getting meaning from text + pictures, sequencing pictures, matching captions, and fuller comprehension (including simple summarising). Reading-aloud fluency stays deferred (oral).

atomic_skills.title: Sigwoordeskat uitbrei (expand sight vocabulary)
atomic_skills.description: Recognise a larger set of Afrikaans sight words by sight, e.g. met, het, op, by, vir, nie, dit, het, was.

error_signatures.description: Learner sounds out high-frequency words instead of recognising them
error_signatures.example: 'maar' read letter by letter.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Show and say the word together a few times. Compare similar-looking words carefully.

atomic_skills.title: Kry betekenis uit teks en prente (get meaning from text + pictures)
atomic_skills.description: Use a short written Afrikaans text with pictures to work out meaning, e.g. choosing the picture that matches the sentence.

error_signatures.description: Learner ignores the picture and guesses from the text alone
error_signatures.example: Doesn't use the picture to disambiguate a homonym.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Read the sentence, then look at each picture and ask which one it could be.

atomic_skills.title: Rangskik prente in volgorde (sequence pictures)
atomic_skills.description: Put pictures of a short Afrikaans story in logical order using the text as a guide.

error_signatures.description: Pictures placed out of story order
error_signatures.example: End placed first.

error_signatures.description: Learner ignores 'eers / toe / daarna' cues
error_signatures.example: 'Toe ...' clause placed before 'Eers ...'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Find the first event together, then ask 'what happened next?' for each step.

atomic_skills.title: Pas onderskrifte by prente (match captions to pictures)
atomic_skills.description: Match longer Afrikaans captions (a short sentence) to the correct picture.

error_signatures.description: Learner matches caption to the wrong picture
error_signatures.example: 'Die seun lees' attached to a sleeping boy.

error_signatures.description: Learner ignores an adjective in the caption
error_signatures.example: ''n groot hond' matched to a small dog.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Read each caption word by word and check the picture detail it names.

atomic_skills.title: Beantwoord begripsvrae en som op (comprehension & simple summary)
atomic_skills.description: Answer comprehension questions on a short Afrikaans text and pick the best 1-sentence summary of what it was about.

error_signatures.description: Learner replaces a fact with a similar one in a summary
error_signatures.example: Text says two apples; learner says three.

error_signatures.description: Learner's summary leaves out the main event
error_signatures.example: Summary mentions only that 'the boy was happy' but not what he did.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Re-read, then ask 'what is the whole thing mostly about?' before offering summary choices.

tiers.title: Taalstruktuur en -gebruik (Language structure & use)
tiers.description: Grade 2 grammar: the PAST TENSE (het ge-), sequence/timelines, expanded question words (Wanneer/Waar), object pronouns, the linking verb 'is', a wider range of adjectives/verbs, and extended plurals.

atomic_skills.title: Verlede tyd (past tense: het ge-)
atomic_skills.description: Understand and form the Afrikaans past tense with 'het' + ge-verb, e.g. 'Ek het gespeel', 'Sy het haar gesig gewas'.

error_signatures.description: Learner forms past tense without 'het'
error_signatures.example: 'Ek gespeel' instead of 'Ek het gespeel'.

error_signatures.description: Learner forgets the ge- prefix on the past participle
error_signatures.example: 'Hy het loop' instead of 'Hy het geloop'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Contrast 'Ek speel' (now) with 'Ek het gespeel' (done). Point out 'het' + the ge- on the verb.

atomic_skills.title: Tydlyne en volgorde (timelines & sequence)
atomic_skills.description: Understand and use Afrikaans sequence words: Eers ... en toe ... Daarna ... Uiteindelik.

error_signatures.description: Learner can't place events on a timeline
error_signatures.example: Reads 'gister' as later than 'môre'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Lay three events on a line and label them eers/toe/daarna. Re-tell a routine the child knows.

atomic_skills.title: Vraagsinne uitgebrei (expanded questions: Wanneer? Waar?)
atomic_skills.description: Understand and use 'Wanneer?' (when) and 'Waar?' (where), alongside the Grade 1 question words.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks 'Wanneer' when 'Waar' was needed (or vice versa)
error_signatures.example: 'Wanneer is Karel?' for a location question.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Tie 'Wanneer?' to a time answer and 'Waar?' to a place answer. Match question to the kind of answer.

atomic_skills.title: Voorwerpsvoornaamwoorde (object pronouns: my, hom, haar)
atomic_skills.description: Understand and use Afrikaans object pronouns: my (me), jou (you), hom (him), haar (her), ons (us), hulle (them), e.g. 'Sy help my'.

error_signatures.description: Subject form used where object form is needed
error_signatures.example: 'Ek sien hy' instead of 'Ek sien hom'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Show who receives the action (She helps ME). Practise my/hom/haar in short sentences.

atomic_skills.title: Koppelwerkwoord 'is' (linking verb 'is')
atomic_skills.description: Understand and use the linking verb 'is', e.g. 'Sy is gelukkig', 'Die hond is groot', 'Ek is moeg'.

error_signatures.description: Learner drops the linking verb 'is'
error_signatures.example: 'Sy 'n onderwyser' instead of 'Sy is 'n onderwyser'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Join a subject to a describing word with 'is' (Sy + is + bly). Use feelings the child knows.

atomic_skills.title: Meer byvoeglike naamwoorde en werkwoorde (more adjectives & verbs)
atomic_skills.description: Understand a wider range of Afrikaans describing words and verbs, e.g. lekker, vinnig, lank, kort; loop, val, lag, huil.

error_signatures.description: Adjective picked where verb is needed or vice versa
error_signatures.example: 'Sy stadig' (adverb missing 'is' or verb) — wrong word picked.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Match each new word to a clear picture or action. Practise opposites (lank/kort).

atomic_skills.title: Meervoude uitgebrei (extended plurals)
atomic_skills.description: Form a wider range of Afrikaans plurals: -e, -s, -te, and common irregulars (oog->oë, kind->kinders, blom->blomme).

error_signatures.description: Learner regularises an irregular plural
error_signatures.example: kind → 'kinde' instead of 'kinders'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Group nouns by plural ending and practise one group at a time. Flag irregulars as 'special words'.

levels.title: Graad 3 — Afrikaans Eerste Addisionele Taal
levels.description: CAPS Foundation Phase Grade 3 FAL — the richest year. Klanke completes the decoding system (extended consonant blends, 10+ diphthongs, two-vowel sounds, the e-as-i and d-as-t spellings, consonant-cluster blending, suffixes). Taalstruktuur adds the FUTURE tense (sal) and contrasts all three tenses, plus articles, degrees of comparison, demonstratives. Reading adds summarising non-fiction and using diagrams. Vocabulary target: 1500-2500 words by year end. Knowledge-core scope: Speaking-production and Writing/Handwriting remain deferred. Skills prerequisite their Grade 2 counterparts.

tiers.title: Luister (Listening comprehension)
tiers.description: Fuller comprehension: why-questions, predicting the next event, and listening to non-fiction (factual recounts, procedures) then answering and summarising.

atomic_skills.title: Beantwoord begripsvrae — insluitend Waarom (comprehension incl. why)
atomic_skills.description: Listen to an Afrikaans story or account and answer comprehension questions, including 'Waarom?' (why) questions that need a reason.

error_signatures.description: Asked 'Waarom?'; learner gives a 'what' answer
error_signatures.example: Story says the boy ran because it rained; learner says 'he ran fast'.

error_signatures.description: Learner reverses cause and effect
error_signatures.example: Says the rain happened because the boy ran.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Re-read the cause-and-effect sentence. For 'why', point to the part of the story that gives the reason.

atomic_skills.title: Voorspel wat volgende gebeur (predict the next event)
atomic_skills.description: Listen to part of an Afrikaans story and predict what will happen next from the clues.

error_signatures.description: Prediction not grounded in the heard cues
error_signatures.example: Dark clouds + wind clues; learner predicts a picnic.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Recap what has happened, then ask 'what makes sense next?' Rule out options that do not fit the clues.

atomic_skills.title: Luister na niefiksie en som op (non-fiction: answer & summarise)
atomic_skills.description: Listen to a short Afrikaans non-fiction text (a factual recount or information) and answer questions / pick the best summary.

error_signatures.description: Learner gives a detail as the summary of a non-fiction text
error_signatures.example: Text about bees; learner's summary is just 'they have wings'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Re-read each fact. Ask 'what is the whole thing about?' before offering summary choices.

tiers.title: Klanke (Phonics / decoding)
tiers.description: Grade 3 completes the Afrikaans decoding system: extended consonant blends, 10+ diphthongs, two-vowel sounds (ei/eu/ou), the e-that-sounds-like-i and d-that-sounds-like-t, blending consonant clusters, and suffixes. All audio-first with letters shown.

atomic_skills.title: Konsonanttweeklanke uitgebrei (extended consonant blends)
atomic_skills.description: Recognise more Afrikaans consonant blends at start/end, e.g. sm-, spr-, str-, skr-, -ld, -rg (smul, spring, straat, veld, berg).

error_signatures.description: Consonant blend split into two separate sounds
error_signatures.example: 'strand' read as 's-t-rand'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Say the cluster joined (spr, str) before the rest. Build from the blend outward.

atomic_skills.title: Diftonge (diphthongs: eeu, aai, ooi, oei)
atomic_skills.description: Recognise Afrikaans triple-letter diphthongs: eeu (leeu), aai (draai), ooi (mooi), oei (koei).

error_signatures.description: Diphthong (aai, ooi, oei, eeu) split into separate vowels
error_signatures.example: 'koei' read as 'ko-ei'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Stretch the glide sound and link to a key word (oei -> koei). Compare two diphthongs at a time.

atomic_skills.title: Twee-vokaal klanke (two-vowel sounds: ei, eu, ou)
atomic_skills.description: Recognise Afrikaans two-vowel sounds: ei (trein), eu (seun), ou (koud).

error_signatures.description: Vowel digraph (ei, eu, ou) split into separate vowels
error_signatures.example: 'seun' read as 'se-un'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Link each sound to a key word (eu -> seun). Contrast with a single vowel (ou in koud vs o in kos).

atomic_skills.title: Klanke wat verskil (e-as-i, d-as-t)
atomic_skills.description: Recognise where Afrikaans spelling and sound differ: the unstressed 'e' that sounds like 'i' (water, later) and the word-final 'd' that sounds like 't' (brood, bed).

error_signatures.description: Learner confuses near sounds (e-as-i, d-as-t at word end)
error_signatures.example: 'sit' read with a long 'see' sound.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Say the word naturally, then point to the letter that sounds different. Group examples of the same rule.

atomic_skills.title: Bou woorde met konsonantgroepe (blend consonant clusters)
atomic_skills.description: Blend and segment Afrikaans words with consonant clusters, e.g. dr-i-nk, spr-ing, str-aat.

error_signatures.description: Learner can't blend a 3+ consonant cluster
error_signatures.example: 'spraak' read as 'sp-raak' with a pause.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Keep the cluster together as one unit while blending the rest of the word.

atomic_skills.title: Agtervoegsels (suffixes)
atomic_skills.description: Recognise and use common Afrikaans suffixes: -tjie/-jie (little), -e/-s (more than one), -er/-ste (comparison).

error_signatures.description: Learner drops a suffix when reading
error_signatures.example: 'mooie' read as 'mooi'.

error_signatures.description: Learner reads the wrong suffix
error_signatures.example: '-tjie' read as '-jie'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Show the base word, then add the ending and say what it changes (little / more / most).

atomic_skills.title: Herken rymwoorde — uitgebrei (rhyme, more complex)
atomic_skills.description: Recognise rhyming Afrikaans words, including more complex words, e.g. kom/som/dom, spring/sing/ding.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks words that share a starting sound, not an ending sound
error_signatures.example: 'kat / koek' picked as rhyming instead of 'kat / mat'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Exaggerate the ending. Compare two words before three.

tiers.title: Woordeskat (Vocabulary, themed)
tiers.description: Grade 3 themes lean on comparison/description and non-fiction topics ('find out about ...'). Building toward 1500-2500 words. Image-match keys in afrikaans-image-manifest.md; audio + English-meaning fallback until images exist.

atomic_skills.title: Beskrywende woorde (descriptive words)
atomic_skills.description: Afrikaans describing words that support comparison: groot, klein, lank, kort, swaar, lig, vinnig, stadig.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks the opposite descriptor
error_signatures.example: Asked for 'groot'; picks 'klein'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Match each word to a clear picture. Teach in opposite pairs (swaar/lig).

atomic_skills.title: Teenoorgesteldes (opposites)
atomic_skills.description: Common Afrikaans opposite pairs: oop/toe, vinnig/stadig, warm/koud, groot/klein, lank/kort, bly/hartseer.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks a synonym when antonym is asked (or vice versa)
error_signatures.example: Opposite of 'warm'; picks 'lekker' (synonym) instead of 'koud'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Always present the pair together. Use a picture or action that shows the contrast.

atomic_skills.title: Diere en hul lewe (animals & their life — non-fiction)
atomic_skills.description: Afrikaans non-fiction vocabulary about animals: leef, woon, eet, troppe, wild, mak, groot/klein diere.

error_signatures.description: Learner matches an animal to the wrong habitat or food
error_signatures.example: 'leeu' matched to 'eet gras'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Tie each word to a clear animal picture or fact the child knows.

atomic_skills.title: Plekke in die dorp (places in town)
atomic_skills.description: Afrikaans place words: winkel, skool, huis, hospitaal, park, kerk, biblioteek.

error_signatures.description: Learner matches a place to the wrong activity
error_signatures.example: 'hospitaal' matched to 'koop kos'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Link each place to what you do there (winkel -> koop). Use clear building pictures.

atomic_skills.title: Vervoer (transport)
atomic_skills.description: Afrikaans transport words: motor, bus, trein, fiets, vliegtuig, boot, vragmotor.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks a vehicle that doesn't match the context
error_signatures.example: 'bus' picked when the text says 'trein' (rails).

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Match each word to a clear vehicle picture, and to where it travels (lug/water/pad).

tiers.title: Lees & Kyk (Reading & viewing)
tiers.description: Grade 3 reading: posters/headings in the environment, fuller comprehension (incl. why), ordering events, summarising non-fiction, and using diagrams/illustrations to understand. Reading-aloud fluency stays deferred (oral).

atomic_skills.title: Lees plakkate en opskrifte (read posters & headings)
atomic_skills.description: Read simple Afrikaans posters/headings from the environment and work out what they mean.

error_signatures.description: Learner can read the poster aloud but can't say what it means
error_signatures.example: Reads 'PASOP VIR DIE HOND' but can't pick 'Beware of the dog'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Read the heading word by word; use any picture on the poster as a clue.

atomic_skills.title: Beantwoord begripsvrae — uitgebrei (comprehension incl. why)
atomic_skills.description: Read a short Afrikaans text and answer comprehension questions, including 'Waarom?' questions.

error_signatures.description: Asked 'Waarom?'; learner answers with a literal 'what'
error_signatures.example: Asked why the girl smiled; learner says she smiled.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Re-read the sentence that gives the reason. Underline cause-and-effect words.

atomic_skills.title: Rangskik gebeure in volgorde (order events)
atomic_skills.description: Read a short Afrikaans story and put its events in logical order.

error_signatures.description: Events ordered incorrectly
error_signatures.example: End placed before beginning.

error_signatures.description: Time markers ignored when ordering
error_signatures.example: Ignores 'Eers / Toe / Daarna'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Find the first event, then ask 'what happened next?' for each step.

atomic_skills.title: Som 'n niefiksie-teks op (summarise non-fiction)
atomic_skills.description: Read a short Afrikaans non-fiction text (factual recount/information) and choose the best summary.

error_signatures.description: Picks a detail instead of the overall idea
error_signatures.example: Summary for an animals text picks only 'lions eat meat'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Ask 'what is the whole text mostly about?' Rule out details that are too small to be the summary.

atomic_skills.title: Gebruik diagramme en illustrasies (use diagrams & illustrations)
atomic_skills.description: Use an Afrikaans labelled diagram or illustration to answer questions about the text.

error_signatures.description: Learner reads the wrong label on a diagram
error_signatures.example: Plant diagram — picks 'blare' when the arrow points at the root.

error_signatures.description: Learner ignores arrow direction on a diagram
error_signatures.example: Says the highlighted part is the leaves when the arrow points at the stem.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Point to the labelled part of the diagram that answers the question.

tiers.title: Taalstruktuur en -gebruik (Language structure & use)
tiers.description: Grade 3 grammar: the FUTURE tense (sal) and all three tenses contrasted, articles ('n/die), degrees of comparison, demonstratives (hierdie/daardie/dit), a variety of question sentences, and consolidating nouns/plurals.

atomic_skills.title: Toekomende tyd (future tense: sal)
atomic_skills.description: Understand and form the Afrikaans future tense with 'sal' + verb, e.g. 'Ek sal speel', 'Sy sal kom'.

error_signatures.description: Future tense formed without 'sal' / 'gaan'
error_signatures.example: 'Ek speel môre' picked as future-tense form instead of 'Ek sal môre speel'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Tie 'sal' to something not yet done (later/môre). Contrast with the past 'het'.

atomic_skills.title: Al drie tye (present, past, future contrasted)
atomic_skills.description: Tell apart and choose the right Afrikaans tense: present (Ek speel), past (Ek het gespeel), future (Ek sal speel).

error_signatures.description: Learner picks the wrong tense for the time signal
error_signatures.example: Sentence has 'gister'; learner picks present-tense verb.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Anchor each tense to a time word: nou (present), gister (past), môre (future).

atomic_skills.title: Lidwoorde ('n, die)
atomic_skills.description: Use the Afrikaans articles ''n' (a/an) and 'die' (the) correctly with nouns.

error_signatures.description: Learner uses 'die' for a first mention or ''n' for a known referent
error_signatures.example: ''n son skyn' instead of 'Die son skyn'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Use ''n' for any one (a dog) and 'die' for a specific one (the dog we know).

atomic_skills.title: Trappe van vergelyking (degrees of comparison)
atomic_skills.description: Understand and use Afrikaans comparison: groot, groter, die grootste; vinnig, vinniger, die vinnigste.

error_signatures.description: Comparative used where superlative is needed (or vice versa)
error_signatures.example: 'die grootter' instead of 'die grootste'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Line up three things small-to-big and label them: groot, groter, grootste. Stress -er and -ste.

atomic_skills.title: Aanwysende voornaamwoorde (demonstratives)
atomic_skills.description: Understand and use Afrikaans demonstratives: hierdie (this), daardie (that), dit (it).

error_signatures.description: Learner picks 'hierdie' for a far object or 'daardie' for a near one
error_signatures.example: 'daardie boek' for the book on the desk in front of you.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Point near (hierdie) and far (daardie) with real objects. Practise the pair together.

atomic_skills.title: Vraagsinne (Watter? Waarom?)
atomic_skills.description: Understand and use a variety of Afrikaans question words, including 'Watter?' (which) and 'Waarom?' (why).

error_signatures.description: Learner picks the wrong question word (Watter vs Waarom)
error_signatures.example: 'Watter rede?' picked when 'Waarom?' was needed.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Tie 'Watter?' to a choice between options and 'Waarom?' to a reason (omdat ...).

atomic_skills.title: Selfstandige naamwoorde en meervoude (nouns & plurals consolidated)
atomic_skills.description: Recognise Afrikaans nouns (incl. uncountable: suiker, sand, water) and consolidate plural forms.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks the wrong plural ending
error_signatures.example: 'kinde' instead of 'kinders'.

error_signatures.description: Learner adds a plural ending to an uncountable noun
error_signatures.example: 'suikere' for 'suiker'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Sort words into 'things you can count' and 'things you cannot count' (suiker, sand). Review plural endings.

levels.title: Graad 4 — Afrikaans Eerste Addisionele Taal
levels.description: CAPS Intermediate Phase Grade 4 FAL. Reading and writing become first-class strands. Strands: Luister (receptive), Lees en Kyk, Skryf en Aanbied (typed cloze/sentence only), Taalstrukture. Praat (speaking aloud) and long-form essay writing remain deferred. Vocabulary target: ~1700 words by year end. Reading texts run ~60-80 words.

tiers.title: Luister (Listening comprehension)
tiers.description: Receptive listening only (Praat / speaking-aloud is deferred — needs voice capture). Audio plays Afrikaans; the learner taps/chooses. At IP level the content shifts from FP greetings to multi-step instructions, longer narratives, opinions, and figurative language.

atomic_skills.title: Volg meer-stap gesproke instruksies (follow multi-step spoken instructions)
atomic_skills.description: Listen to two- or three-step Afrikaans instructions and choose what to do, e.g. 'Trek 'n sirkel, kleur dit blou, en skryf jou naam.'

error_signatures.description: The learner skips one of the steps in a multi-step instruction
error_signatures.example: Asked to 'draw a circle and colour it red', the learner draws the circle but doesn't colour it.

error_signatures.description: Steps performed but in the wrong order
error_signatures.example: Learner colours first and then draws — reversing the instructions.

error_signatures.description: A critical detail (colour, place, number) is not heard or chosen
error_signatures.example: Learner taps the wrong colour because they missed 'rooi' in the audio.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Replay slowly. Confirm step 1 before step 2; have the learner repeat the steps back.

atomic_skills.title: Beantwoord vrae oor 'n gehoorde storie (answer Q's about a heard story)
atomic_skills.description: Listen to a short Afrikaans story (~60 words) and answer wie/wat/waar/wanneer comprehension questions.

error_signatures.description: Learner cannot recall a literal detail (who/what/when) from the audio
error_signatures.example: Story said 'pienk sambreel' but learner picks 'blou sambreel'.

error_signatures.description: Learner mixes up who did what in a multi-character story
error_signatures.example: Themba won the race, but learner says it was the coach.

error_signatures.description: Learner misreads time words (saans, oggend, naweek)
error_signatures.example: Learner says the event happens in the morning when audio said 'saans'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Re-read one sentence at a time and ask the matching question. Use the picture / context as a cue.

atomic_skills.title: Maak voorspellings tydens luister (predict during listening)
atomic_skills.description: Listen to part of an Afrikaans story / account and choose the most likely next event from clues.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks an option not supported by the audio cues
error_signatures.example: Audio mentions dark clouds and wind, but learner predicts sunshine.

error_signatures.description: Learner chooses an option only because words match, not because it makes sense
error_signatures.example: Learner picks an option that re-uses a noun from the audio but doesn't follow logically.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Pause at the clue sentence and underline (read aloud) the words that hint at what comes next.

atomic_skills.title: Hervertel die volgorde van gebeure (retell the order of events)
atomic_skills.description: Hear a short Afrikaans story and put the events back in the correct order.

error_signatures.description: Events recalled in the wrong order
error_signatures.example: Learner places 'breakfast' before 'wake up'.

error_signatures.description: Learner drops an event entirely from the sequence
error_signatures.example: Four-step story but learner orders only three events.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Walk through the story event by event; place each one on a timeline before choosing.

atomic_skills.title: Volg 'n eenvoudige dialoog (follow a simple dialogue)
atomic_skills.description: Listen to a short conversation between two Afrikaans speakers and answer who said what.

error_signatures.description: Learner attributes a line to the wrong speaker
error_signatures.example: Dad says 'wil jy melk hê?' but learner says Karel asked.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks the question as the response (or vice versa)
error_signatures.example: Dialogue asks 'Hoe oud is jy?' and learner picks the question option instead of the answer.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Replay with each speaker labelled (Speaker 1 / Speaker 2). Match each line to who said it before answering.

atomic_skills.title: Verstaan alledaagse uitdrukkings (understand everyday expressions)
atomic_skills.description: Recognise common Afrikaans expressions and chunks heard in everyday talk, e.g. 'Mag ek asseblief...', 'Wat is jou naam?', 'Hoeveel kos dit?'.

error_signatures.description: Learner translates the expression word-for-word instead of using the chunk meaning
error_signatures.example: 'Lekker dag verder' interpreted as 'tasty day further' rather than 'have a nice day'.

error_signatures.description: Learner can't distinguish polite from informal usage
error_signatures.example: Learner picks 'jy' option in a sentence using 'u' (formal).

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Anchor each expression to a familiar scene (asking a shopkeeper, meeting a friend) and give the English meaning as a hint before the choices.

tiers.title: Lees en Kyk (Reading & Viewing)
tiers.description: The major IP strand. Learners read full Afrikaans stories, factual / information texts, poems, and media (posters, ads, news). Items present the text in `context` and ask comprehension, prediction, summarising, inferring, and visual-literacy questions.

atomic_skills.title: Pre-lees: voorspel uit titel en prente (pre-read: predict from title and pictures)
atomic_skills.description: Use the title, headings and any picture / illustration of an Afrikaans text to predict what it is about before reading.

error_signatures.description: Learner ignores the meaningful word in the title
error_signatures.example: Title 'Die Verlore Hondjie' — learner picks a zoo trip, ignoring 'hondjie'.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks a wrong specific outcome rather than the broad topic
error_signatures.example: Title 'Sport by die Skool' — learner picks 'a rugby final' instead of the topic 'sport at school'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Cover the body of the text; ask 'Wat sien jy? Wat dink jy gaan gebeur?' before revealing.

atomic_skills.title: Lees en verstaan 'n kort storie (read and understand a short story, 60-80 words)
atomic_skills.description: Read a short Afrikaans story (60-80 words) and answer comprehension questions about characters, setting and events.

error_signatures.description: Learner replaces a story detail with a similar but wrong one
error_signatures.example: Story has a green ball; learner says red ball.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks an option that goes beyond what the story states
error_signatures.example: Story doesn't say where they went after the park; learner picks a wrong location.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Re-read the story one sentence at a time. Underline the words that answer each question.

atomic_skills.title: Beantwoord wie/wat/waar/wanneer-vrae (answer literal who/what/where/when questions)
atomic_skills.description: Find facts in a short Afrikaans text and answer literal comprehension questions.

error_signatures.description: Learner can't find the literal answer in the text
error_signatures.example: Bus time is in the text but learner guesses.

error_signatures.description: Learner answers a different W-question than asked
error_signatures.example: Question asks WHEN; learner gives a WHO answer.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Point to where in the text the answer comes from. Highlight that exact sentence.

atomic_skills.title: Vind hoofidee in 'n inligtingsteks (find the main idea in an information text)
atomic_skills.description: Read a short Afrikaans information text and identify what it is mainly about (not just a detail).

error_signatures.description: Learner picks a supporting detail as the main idea
error_signatures.example: Text about teeth-care; learner picks 'sugar makes holes' instead of the broader topic.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks a too-narrow option
error_signatures.example: Picks 'apples' when text is about fruit in general.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Cover everything but the heading and first/last sentence — the main idea usually lives there.

atomic_skills.title: Lees 'n eenvoudige prosedureteks (read a simple procedure / how-to)
atomic_skills.description: Read a short Afrikaans procedure (recipe, craft instructions, game rules) and answer questions about order and ingredients.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks the wrong-ordered step in a how-to
error_signatures.example: Picks 'add milk' before 'boil water' in a tea recipe.

error_signatures.description: Learner can't identify which step is missing or last
error_signatures.example: Asked for the LAST step, learner picks step 2.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Number each step. Match each question to the numbered step that holds the answer.

atomic_skills.title: Lees 'n eenvoudige gedig — rym en ritme (read a simple poem — rhyme and rhythm)
atomic_skills.description: Read a short Afrikaans rhyming poem and identify rhyming pairs, line repetition, and overall feeling.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks lines that don't actually rhyme
error_signatures.example: Picks 'speel / lag' instead of 'bal / val'.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks an opposite feeling for the poem
error_signatures.example: Playful poem; learner picks 'scary'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Read aloud and clap the rhythm. Circle the words that sound the same at the end.

atomic_skills.title: Visuele geletterdheid: plakkaat / advertensie (visual literacy: poster / ad)
atomic_skills.description: Read a simple Afrikaans poster or ad and identify what it wants the reader to do, when, and where.

error_signatures.description: Learner misidentifies who the poster is for
error_signatures.example: Family bazaar; learner says 'for farmers only'.

error_signatures.description: Learner can't tell what the poster wants the reader to do
error_signatures.example: Poster invites to a bazaar; learner picks an unrelated action.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Look at the picture first — who is it speaking to? Then read the big words, then the small print.

atomic_skills.title: Leid betekenis van onbekende woorde af uit konteks (infer unknown words from context)
atomic_skills.description: When you meet an unfamiliar Afrikaans word in a text, work out its meaning from the surrounding sentence and any picture.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks a meaning that doesn't fit the sentence context
error_signatures.example: 'Die kos is GAAR' — learner picks 'raw' instead of 'cooked / ready'.

error_signatures.description: Learner guesses based on a similar-sounding English word
error_signatures.example: 'GLIBBERIG' guessed as 'glittery' instead of 'slippery'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Cover the unknown word; ask what word would make sense there. Then reveal and confirm with the options.

tiers.title: Skryf en Aanbied (Writing & Presenting)
tiers.description: Typed-only writing, kept at sentence / cloze level so it can be auto-marked (no LLM essay grading in scope). Templates: cloze (fill missing words), sequence (order sentences), choice (pick the right sentence form). Long-form essay grading is Phase 3.

atomic_skills.title: Voltooi sinne (complete sentences via cloze)
atomic_skills.description: Fill in the missing word in a short Afrikaans sentence so it makes sense and matches the picture / context.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks a wrong part of speech for the gap
error_signatures.example: Gap needs a verb; learner picks a noun.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks past tense where present is needed (or vice versa)
error_signatures.example: Sentence is present tense; learner picks 'gespeel' (past).

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Read the sentence with each option in the gap; which one makes a true sentence?

atomic_skills.title: Skryf 'n eenvoudige lys (write a simple list — shopping, classroom, weekend)
atomic_skills.description: Build a short Afrikaans list (4-6 items) by choosing which words belong on the list (e.g. items for a picnic).

error_signatures.description: Learner picks an item that doesn't belong on the list
error_signatures.example: Adds 'stoel' (chair) to a fruit list.

error_signatures.description: Learner removes a correct item and keeps an irrelevant one
error_signatures.example: Drops 'appel' from fruit list and keeps 'brood'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Cluster items by category first (food / drink / utensils) before deciding what to include.

atomic_skills.title: Vul 'n cloze-paragraaf in (5-7 leemtes)
atomic_skills.description: Read a short Afrikaans paragraph with 5-7 missing words and fill each gap with the right word from a word bank.

error_signatures.description: Learner fills some gaps and skips others
error_signatures.example: 5-gap paragraph; learner answers only 3 gaps.

error_signatures.description: Word chosen doesn't agree with the surrounding nouns/verbs
error_signatures.example: Picks a singular noun where the verb form needs plural.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Read the whole paragraph first to get the gist, then fill the easiest gaps before the harder ones.

atomic_skills.title: Plaas sinne in storievolgorde (sequence sentences into a story)
atomic_skills.description: Put 4-6 short Afrikaans sentences in the correct order so they tell a coherent story.

error_signatures.description: Learner's sentence order doesn't tell a coherent story
error_signatures.example: Puts 'eat' before 'wake up'.

error_signatures.description: Learner ignores 'eers/toe/daarna/laastens' cues when sequencing
error_signatures.example: Story has 'Eers ... daarna ...' clearly; learner still picks the wrong order.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Look for time words (eerstens, toe, daarna, laastens) and pronouns that refer back. Find the beginning first.

atomic_skills.title: Skryf eenvoudige instruksies (write simple instructions via cloze)
atomic_skills.description: Complete a short Afrikaans procedure (3-5 steps) by choosing the missing verb or detail in each step.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks a verb that doesn't match the step
error_signatures.example: Step 1 'open the tap'; learner chooses 'eat the tap'.

error_signatures.description: Procedure built in the wrong sequence
error_signatures.example: Boil → measure → mix written as measure → boil → mix.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Imagine actually doing the task — what is the very first thing you'd pick up or check?

tiers.title: Taalstrukture en -konvensies (Language structures)
tiers.description: Afrikaans grammar, punctuation and vocabulary in context. CAPS embeds grammar inside the other strands but here it is its own ladder so progress can be tracked. Items are choice / cloze.

atomic_skills.title: Selfstandige naamwoorde: ekv en mv (nouns: singular and plural)
atomic_skills.description: Form Afrikaans plurals correctly: -e (kat → katte), -s (skoen → skoene), and the common -ies for diminutives carried over (boek → boeke).

error_signatures.description: Learner applies the wrong plural ending
error_signatures.example: kat → 'kats' instead of 'katte'.

error_signatures.description: Learner uses regular -e for an irregular plural
error_signatures.example: kind → 'kinde' instead of 'kinders'.

error_signatures.description: Learner forgets to double the consonant before -e
error_signatures.example: bal → 'bale' instead of 'balle'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Sort words into 'add -e', 'add -s'. Stress the new ending sound when reading the plural aloud.

atomic_skills.title: Werkwoorde — teenwoordige tyd (verbs — present tense)
atomic_skills.description: Use the present tense of common Afrikaans verbs correctly: ek loop, hy speel, ons sing, hulle eet.

error_signatures.description: Learner adds an -s/-t to the verb to 'agree' with the subject
error_signatures.example: Hy 'speels' instead of 'Hy speel'.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks past form when present is required
error_signatures.example: 'Ek het gespeel' picked for a present-tense slot.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Afrikaans is simple in the present — the verb form doesn't change with the subject. Show that ek/jy/hy/sy/ons/julle/hulle all take the same verb.

atomic_skills.title: Persoonlike voornaamwoorde (personal pronouns)
atomic_skills.description: Use Afrikaans personal pronouns: ek, jy, hy, sy, dit, ons, julle, hulle, and object forms my, jou, hom, haar, ons, julle, hulle.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks 'hy' for a female subject (or 'sy' for male)
error_signatures.example: Mia replaced with 'hy' instead of 'sy'.

error_signatures.description: Learner uses subject form where object form is needed
error_signatures.example: 'Ek hou van hy' instead of 'Ek hou van hom'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Show pictures or names; replace them with the right pronoun. Highlight that 'jy/jou' is informal and 'u' is polite.

atomic_skills.title: Byvoeglike naamwoorde (adjectives — describing words)
atomic_skills.description: Use simple Afrikaans adjectives to describe nouns: groot, klein, mooi, lelik, vinnig, stadig.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks an adjective that contradicts the sentence
error_signatures.example: 'Die ys is warm' — learner accepts 'warm'.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks the antonym instead of the synonym (or vice versa)
error_signatures.example: Asked the opposite of 'groot', learner picks 'klein' but for synonym asks the same answer.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Match each adjective to a clear picture or its opposite. Practise the adjective right next to the noun: 'die groot hond'.

atomic_skills.title: Lidwoorde: die / 'n (articles)
atomic_skills.description: Choose between 'die' (the) and ''n' (a/an) correctly in Afrikaans sentences.

error_signatures.description: Learner uses 'die' for a first mention or ''n' for a known referent
error_signatures.example: ''n son skyn' instead of 'Die son skyn'.

error_signatures.description: Learner omits the article altogether
error_signatures.example: 'Ek sien hond' instead of 'Ek sien 'n hond'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Use 'die' for something already known, ''n' for the first time it's mentioned.

atomic_skills.title: Sinsoorte: stelsin, vraagsin, bevelsin (statement / question / command)
atomic_skills.description: Recognise and form three Afrikaans sentence types: statement, question (starts with verb or question word), command (starts with verb).

error_signatures.description: Learner labels a question as a statement (or similar mix-up)
error_signatures.example: 'Is sy bly?' labelled as a statement.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks the wrong end-punctuation
error_signatures.example: Question ended with '.' instead of '?'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Punctuation is the giveaway: . for statement, ? for question, ! for command. Read each sentence aloud with the right tone.

atomic_skills.title: Hoofletters en punte (capitals and full stops)
atomic_skills.description: Apply Afrikaans capitalisation: start of sentences, proper names, place names, days, months; use full stops at sentence ends.

error_signatures.description: Learner doesn't capitalise days or months (English-influenced habit)
error_signatures.example: 'op saterdag' instead of 'op Saterdag'.

error_signatures.description: Place / personal names left in lowercase
error_signatures.example: 'pretoria' instead of 'Pretoria'.

error_signatures.description: Sentence not ended with a full stop
error_signatures.example: 'Sy is my vriendin' — no period.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Underline every word that needs a capital before re-writing. Days of the week ARE capitalised in Afrikaans — point that out.

atomic_skills.title: Woordeskat in konteks (vocabulary in context)
atomic_skills.description: Work out which Afrikaans word fits a given sentence from a small set of similar options.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks a word that doesn't suit the surrounding sentence
error_signatures.example: 'Sy is dors. Sy drink 'n glas klippe' — learner picks 'klippe' instead of 'water'.

error_signatures.description: Picks an item from the wrong semantic field
error_signatures.example: Sentence about food; learner picks an item of clothing.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Read the whole sentence with each option in turn. Eliminate the option that makes the sentence untrue or odd.

levels.title: Graad 5 — Afrikaans Eerste Addisionele Taal
levels.description: CAPS Intermediate Phase Grade 5 FAL. Comprehension shifts from literal to inferential; writing widens from single sentences to scaffolded paragraphs. Reading texts run ~80-120 words. Vocabulary target: ~2500 words. Past tense, diminutives and the double-negative are the new grammar focus.

tiers.title: Luister (Listening comprehension)
tiers.description: Receptive listening only (Praat / speaking-aloud is deferred — needs voice capture). Audio plays Afrikaans; the learner taps/chooses. At IP level the content shifts from FP greetings to multi-step instructions, longer narratives, opinions, and figurative language.

atomic_skills.title: Volg langer mondelinge instruksies in volgorde (follow longer ordered instructions)
atomic_skills.description: Listen to four- to five-step Afrikaans instructions and place the steps in correct order.

error_signatures.description: Steps performed but in wrong order
error_signatures.example: 5-step instruction; learner places step 4 before step 3.

error_signatures.description: A step is skipped in a multi-step instruction
error_signatures.example: Asked for the LAST step; learner gives step 3 of 5.

error_signatures.description: A key time / colour / number in a step is not heard
error_signatures.example: Audio says 'wag drie minute'; learner picks 'ten minutes'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Have the learner say the steps back in their own words before sequencing them.

atomic_skills.title: Vind hoofidee in 'n gehoorde teks (find the main idea in a heard text)
atomic_skills.description: Listen to a short Afrikaans information text and pick the sentence that best states its main idea.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks a supporting detail as the main idea
error_signatures.example: Text on bees; learner picks 'bees can sting' as main idea.

error_signatures.description: Picks a narrow option instead of the broader main idea
error_signatures.example: Text on rhinos in general; learner picks 'baby rhinos' only.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Ask: 'What is the WHOLE text about, not just one part?' Eliminate options that are only one detail.

atomic_skills.title: Maak gevolgtrekkings uit luisterteks (draw inferences from listening)
atomic_skills.description: Listen to an Afrikaans story and answer questions that need reasoning beyond the literal text (how does the character feel? what is implied?).

error_signatures.description: Inference not grounded in the heard clues
error_signatures.example: Audio suggests fear; learner picks 'excited'.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks an option only because words match, missing the underlying meaning
error_signatures.example: Picks a literal option when the question needs inference.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Replay the clue sentence; ask 'Why might they say that?'. Connect tone-of-voice to feeling.

atomic_skills.title: Identifiseer karakter se gevoelens uit toon (identify feelings from tone)
atomic_skills.description: Notice the tone (happy / angry / sad / surprised) of an Afrikaans speaker and match it to the right feeling word.

error_signatures.description: Learner misreads the speaker's tone
error_signatures.example: Soft warm tone interpreted as 'angry'.

error_signatures.description: Learner picks the opposite feeling
error_signatures.example: Excited speaker labelled as 'bored'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Re-listen and copy the tone in your own voice. The feeling word should match how you sound.

atomic_skills.title: Volg 'n kort gedig en herken rym (follow a short poem and recognise rhyme)
atomic_skills.description: Listen to a short Afrikaans rhyming poem and pick the rhyming pair / fill the rhyme.

error_signatures.description: Picks lines that share a starting sound, not an ending sound
error_signatures.example: Picks 'speel / lag' instead of 'bal / val'.

error_signatures.description: Cannot identify which words rhyme at line-ends
error_signatures.example: Picks two unrelated words from the middle of the poem.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Stretch the ending of each line. Compare line endings in pairs.

atomic_skills.title: Verstaan idiome en uitdrukkings (understand common idioms)
atomic_skills.description: Recognise high-frequency Afrikaans idioms and choose the meaning, e.g. 'Hy is 'n boekwurm', 'Dis 'n appel-en-eier'.

error_signatures.description: Translates the idiom word-for-word instead of figuratively
error_signatures.example: 'Hy is 'n boekwurm' interpreted as 'he is a worm in a book'.

error_signatures.description: Picks a meaning that doesn't fit the sentence around the idiom
error_signatures.example: Chooses 'rich' for an idiom that means 'kind'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Give the English equivalent and the literal meaning side by side; show why the figurative meaning makes sense.

tiers.title: Lees en Kyk (Reading & Viewing)
tiers.description: The major IP strand. Learners read full Afrikaans stories, factual / information texts, poems, and media (posters, ads, news). Items present the text in `context` and ask comprehension, prediction, summarising, inferring, and visual-literacy questions.

atomic_skills.title: Pre-lees: gebruik opskrif, byskrif en illustrasies (pre-read with heading, caption, illustrations)
atomic_skills.description: Use the heading, captions and any illustrations of an Afrikaans text to predict content and purpose before reading.

error_signatures.description: Doesn't use the heading's key noun to predict
error_signatures.example: Title mentions 'pannekoek'; learner predicts a science text.

error_signatures.description: Misidentifies the intended audience
error_signatures.example: Says a children's poster is 'for farmers only'.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: List 3 things you expect to find in the text based on the heading. Then check after reading.

atomic_skills.title: Lees en verstaan 'n storie (read a story, 80-120 words)
atomic_skills.description: Read a longer Afrikaans story (80-120 words) and answer questions about plot, characters and setting.

error_signatures.description: Replaces a story detail with a similar but wrong one
error_signatures.example: Story says 'pers fiets'; learner says 'blou fiets'.

error_signatures.description: Picks an option that the text doesn't actually support
error_signatures.example: Goes beyond what the story explicitly says.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: After reading, briefly retell in 1-2 sentences in English before answering the Afrikaans questions.

atomic_skills.title: Beantwoord hoekom/hoe-vrae (answer how / why reasoning questions)
atomic_skills.description: Read an Afrikaans text and answer 'Hoekom?' / 'Hoe?' questions that need a reason or method, not just a fact.

error_signatures.description: Asked 'Hoekom?'; learner gives a literal 'what' answer
error_signatures.example: Question asks WHY mom woke up early; learner answers WHAT she did.

error_signatures.description: Reverses cause and effect
error_signatures.example: Says she drives to work because there's traffic, not vice versa.

atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: Find the cause-and-effect sentence. Look for words like 'omdat', 'want', 'sodat' as signals.
